latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the koompi-legal skill for law firm and legal practice operations.

- Supports case management, document drafting, client communication, billing, deadline tracking, and compliance workflows.
- Includes structured guidelines for the entire matter lifecycle from intake to archiving.
- Implements automated heartbeat checks to flag urgent deadlines, statute of limitations, billing needs, and client communications.
- Details document drafting best practices and provides a template management system.
- Outlines strict rules for billing, time entry, trust accounting, and discovery workflows.
